What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

This post is about the technical architecture behind COREMERCH's digital commerce automation solution, specifically how it uses Google Apps Script, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments to process orders and deliver products to customers without relying on Stripe or any other payment platform. This is a crucial distinction, because it means that digital creators who are locked out of traditional payment processing options can still collect payments and deliver their products to customers. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) are two examples of how this architecture can be deployed in practice, with the Edge Commerce Stack offering additional features like end-to-end testing and SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, the architecture behind COREMERCH's digital commerce automation solution relies on the integration of three key components: Google Apps Script, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments. Google Apps Script is used to automate the backend logic of the digital commerce stack, including order processing and product delivery. Cloudflare Workers is used to handle webhook events and trigger order fulfillment, taking advantage of Cloudflare's free tier capacity of 100,000 webhook events per day. NOWPayments is used for automatic crypto payment verification, with a 0.5% fee and no KYC or buyer account required. When a customer makes a payment, the NOWPayments webhook fires, triggering the Cloudflare Worker to process the order and deliver the product to the customer. This entire process happens in under 30 seconds, and the customer never has to rely on Stripe or any other payment platform to collect their payment.

This includes creators in countries like Nigeria, where Stripe is banned, as well as creators who are working with cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin or USDT. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is the perfect solution for these creators, offering a turnkey digital commerce stack that can be deployed in under 48 hours and includes features like end-to-end testing and SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration. By using this solution, creators can focus on what they do best – creating digital products and engaging with their customers – without worrying about the technical infrastructure holding them back.
